method: Entire pinned single-file SKILL.md read; full root Apache-2.0 text checked and source README inspected. Exact pinned Git tree and blob matched. Static code review and constant arithmetic check only, no ROS runtime/simulation/hardware execution.

rubric_rationale.trigger_precision: Specific ROS/robotics unit, integration, mock, simulation, HIL and regression test triggers; no narrow out-of-scope guard for deployed robot safety.
rubric_rationale.procedural_clarity: Clear tiered testing progression with examples and anti-patterns.
rubric_rationale.authority_safety: Integration examples publish to ordinary ROS topic names and launch ROS nodes; no mandatory isolated ROS_DOMAIN_ID, simulation-only namespace, physical actuator disconnection or hardware owner authorization.
rubric_rationale.failure_handling: Shows negative tests/timeouts, but golden-file test auto-creates baseline from current code and skips if missing; failures can be concealed by first-run acceptance.
rubric_rationale.evidence_discipline: Examples include compile/runtime defects and a wrong strict assertion on rounded quaternion; no proof of representative code execution or tested fixtures.
rubric_rationale.dependency_coherence: Only one owned SKILL.md; snippets rely on project-specific ROS packages, Message types, pytest, hypothesis, numpy, MuJoCo, and GHA dependencies with undeclared example imports.
rubric_rationale.portability_honesty: ROS2 Humble / Ubuntu-22.04 YAML and ROS-specific runtime assumed; not universal across distros, hardware, or agents.
rubric_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: Testing pyramid, property checks, deterministic replay and simulation-before-HIL structure are transferable engineering practices.
rubric_rationale.adversarial_resilience: Does not guard against test-to-live-robot contact; auto-writing golden baseline lets regressions become accepted on a missing fixture.
rubric_rationale.effectiveness_design: Coherent coverage of test layers, but claimed actionable code has concrete defects and real hardware safety is unproven.

positive_methods: Testing pyramid with separate unit/integration/simulation/HIL/field layers
Controlled real-hardware acceptance should follow simulation and lower-risk tests

critical_source_findings.evidence: publish_next uses self.node but __init__ only initializes self.pub, self.step and self.trajectory
if absent, np.save(golden_file, trajectory) then pytest.skip
Launches nodes and publishes to global topics; no explicit ROS_DOMAIN_ID, isolation namespace, hardware owner consent, or actuation prevention

ROS2 Humble and Ubuntu sample CI; authorization for any deployment/robot actions
